description: Two named cards head to head on the person's own spending: which one pays more, and by how much a year. Use this when they are choosing between two specific cards. For 'what should I get', use simulate_cards instead.

departures.description: Flights departed per year, which decides what lounge and companion perks are worth.

filters.description: Must-haves that remove cards before ranking.

foreignPerYear.description: Of that spending, how much is in a foreign currency, per year.

held.description: Card ids the person already carries, so a new card is judged against them.

memberships.description: Membership tags the person already pays for, e.g. amazon_prime, costco_membership.

mode.description: Whether points are valued as cash back or for travel. Defaults to cash.

source.description: A short lowercase slug naming your client, so apply clicks can be attributed. Required.

totals.description: A year's card spending in dollars, by category. Map the person's statement onto these categories with the spending_categories tool first. At least 4 categories must have spending and no single one may exceed 70% of the total, so send the whole picture rather than one category.

years.description: Horizon in years. One of 1, 3 or 5; defaults to 5.

name: compare_two
title: Compare two cards for this person
